# Why defense, military & security keeps re-telling the story of Sḫmt
The myths did not retire. They moved offices. This is the file on where **Sḫmt** works now.

Sekhmet's mythology is dominated by one stupendous story and its aftermath: the day the sun-god sent her to punish humanity, and the trick that turned genocide into festival.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **4 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Sḫmt
- **Pantheon:** Egyptian
- **Domain of influence:** War, Vengeance, Healing
- **Pattern seats:** 4
- **Sectors touched:** Commerce & Governance · Health & Wellbeing · Culture & Entertainment · Home & Lifestyle
- **Strongest seat:** Defense, Military & Security
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 215 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**The Destruction of Mankind.** In the Book of the Heavenly Cow, Re grows old and learns that mankind plots against him.  He sends Sekhmet, his eye, to destroy them. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.

**Daughter of Re, Consort of Ptah.** At Memphis, Sekhmet is the daughter of Re and the consort of Ptah, forming a triad with Nefertem.  As Ptah's fierce complement, she protects the Memphite cosmogony and the kingship it legitimizes. — hold that image; the industries below are where it goes to work.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Defense, Military & Security

*Defense contracting, security services, and strategic studies. (Sector: Commerce & Governance)*

*The lioness of the solar eye, battlefield devourer and plague-bringer — Egypt’s most terrifying expression of military force.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

### Healthcare, Pharma & Medicine

*Medicine, pharmaceuticals, and public health. (Sector: Health & Wellbeing)*

*The Powerful One invoked by Egypt’s physicians against plague.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Sḫmt performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Wine, Brewing & Hospitality

*Vineyards, craft beverage, and hospitality venues. (Sector: Culture & Entertainment)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *Pacified by jars of red-dyed beer in the Destruction of Mankind; brewing literally saved the world.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Pet Care & Animal Industries

*Pet products, veterinary care, and animal brands. (Sector: Home & Lifestyle)*

*The lioness to Bastet’s house cat; Egypt’s other great feline power.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Sekhmet's mythology is dominated by one stupendous story and its aftermath: the day the sun-god sent her to punish humanity, and the trick that turned genocide into festival. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.
## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in defense, military & security, healthcare, pharma & medicine, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/sekhmet/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
